z-m-32-02.title: Umthetho othi 'phindaphinda ukuthambeka ukuthola u-−1' uchaza yonke into mayelana nemigqa emi nkabi?
z-m-32-02.topic: Imigqa emi nkabi nomkhiqizo wokuthambeka kwayo
z-m-32-02.goal: Sebenzisa izibonelo ukuhlola ukuthi umthetho othi 'uma imigqa imi nkabi, umkhiqizo wokuthambeka kwayo ungu-−1' usetshenziswa kuphela uma yomibili imigqa inokuthambeka, bese uqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlola ezibandakanya nemigqa engenakho ukuthambeka.
z-m-32-02.material: UMinseo wafingqa kanje: "Uma imigqa emibili imi nkabi, umkhiqizo wokuthambeka kwayo ungu-−1. Ngakho uma umkhiqizo ungesiyo u-−1, ayimi nkabi." UDoyun wabuza, "Khona-ke umugqa omi mpo u-x=2 nomugqa ovundlile u-y=3 awukwazi ukuphindaphinda ukuthambeka kwawo, ngakho ayimi nkabi, akunjalo?" Cabanga ukuthi wonke umugqa unwebeka ngokuqonda ngaphandle kokuphela ezinhlangothini zombili, futhi amayunithi kuma-axis okuxhumanisa ayafana. (U-x=2 ngumugqa lapho inani luka-x lihlala lingu-2, umugqa omi mpo ohambisana ne-y-axis. U-y=3 ngumugqa ovundlile ohambisana ne-x-axis.)
z-m-32-02.thinking.0: Ukuthola ibanga (isimo) lapho umthetho usebenza khona
z-m-32-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yokuthambeka komugqa u-y=mx+n (imisebenzi eqondile yesikole esiphakathi)
z-m-32-02.prereq.1: Usevele wafunda kanye isimo sokuma nkabi esithi 'uma imigqa emibili imi nkabi, umkhiqizo wokuthambeka kwayo ungu-−1'
z-m-32-02.s.s1.prompt: Njengoba isibonelo ngasinye sidalulwa, khetha isahlulelo mayelana nokuthi umthetho kaMinseo usebenza kanjani.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.hint.0: Esibonelweni ngasinye, qala ngokuhlola ukuthi yomibili imigqa inokuthambeka yini.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlunga izibonelo zibe lezo lapho umthetho usebenza nalezo lapho kunzima ukuhlulela ngomthetho, bese uzibhala ethebuleni.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Umugqa l: y=3x−1, umugqa m: y=−(1/3)x+2 (ukuthambeka luka-m kungu-minus ingxenye yesithathu).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Umkhiqizo wokuthambeka ngu-3×(−1/3)=−1, ngakho ngomthetho kaMinseo imi nkabi.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lesi kungaba yisahlulelo esisekelwe ekubeni ukuthambeka kuhlukile kuphela. Ukwazi ukuthi imigqa imi nkabi yini, udinga ukubheka ukuthi ukuthambeka kuhlobana kanjani.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi sahlulelo sibheka ukuthi ukuthambeka okubili kuhlobana kanjani. Ungasho isizathu sokusebenzisa umthetho kulesi simo?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Cabanga ukuthi kukhona yini umthetho ongawusebenzisa ukuhlulela ngolwazi lwama-equation, ngisho nangaphandle kwesithombe.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Cabanga umugqa l: x=2 (umugqa omi mpo) nomugqa m: y=3 (umugqa ovundlile).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Le migqa emibili imi nkabi? Kwenzekani emthethweni kaMinseo?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Umugqa omi mpo nomugqa ovundlile bahlangana nge-engeli elungile, ngakho bami nkabi. Kodwa umugqa omi mpo awunakho ukuthambeka, ngakho awukwazi ukuhlola ngomthetho othi 'umkhiqizo ungu-−1'. Umthetho kaMinseo udinga isimo esithi 'uma yomibili imigqa inokuthambeka'.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ayimi nkabi. Awukwazi ukuphindaphinda ukuthambeka, ngakho umkhiqizo awukwazi ukuba ngu-−1
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo siguqula 'umphumela womthetho awungu-−1' ube 'ayimi ngqo.' Qala usebenze ukuthi ngemigqa umthetho ongasetshenziswa kuyo yini.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Awukwazi ukunquma ukuthi iyema ngqo yini. Ngaphandle kwe-slope awukwazi ukwahlulela
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa umthetho kuhlukile ekungakwazini ukwahlulela. I-engeli eyenziwa umugqa omile nomugqa ovundlile ingahlolwa ngenye indlela.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Iyema ngqo. Kodwa umugqa omile awunayo i-slope, ngakho awukwazi ukuhlola ngomthetho womphumela
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sicabanga ngokwehlukana ngomkhawulo womthetho nangokuthi yiluphi i-engeli eyenziwa yimigqa emibili.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Umugqa l: 3x+4y−5=0, umugqa m: 4x−3y+7=0. (Ama-coefficient ka-x angu-3 no-4, futhi ama-coefficient ka-y angu-4 no-−3.)
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Khetha indlela eyodwa efanele yokuhlola ukuthi imigqa emibili iyema ngqo yini.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Endleleni a ama-slope angu-−3/4 no-4/3 futhi umphumela wawo ungu-−1, ngakho ayema ngqo. Endleleni c, 3×4+4×(−3)=0, ngakho nayo iyema ngqo. Indlela c ingasetshenziswa njengoba injalo ku-x=2 (1x+0y−2=0) no-y=3 (0x+1y−3=0), njengoba 1×0+0×1=0. Endleleni b, 3×4=12 akuyona umphumela wama-slope, ngakho akuyona isizathu esifanele.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Bhala kabusha zombili izibalo ngohlobo y=mx+n, uthole ama-slope, bese uwaphindaphinda
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Le yindlela oyisebenzisa ngemva kokuhlola isimo somthetho (yomibili imigqa inama-slope).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hlola ukuthi umphumela wama-coefficient ka-x ungu-−1 yini
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kungenzeka ushiye ukuthi umthetho ukhuluma nge-slope. Ingabe i-slope iyinani elifanayo ne-coefficient ka-x?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Engeza umphumela wama-coefficient ka-x nomphumela wama-coefficient ka-y, bese uhlola ukuthi ungu-0 yini
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Le yindlela ezama ukwahlulela ngaphandle kokuthola ama-slope. Kuyafaneleka ukuhlola ukuthi isebenza nasemigqeni efana no-x=2 no-y=3 yini.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.reflect: Ngemva komibuzo ka-Doyun, inkolelo yakho ngomthetho ka-Minseo yashintsha kanjani? Ingabe uwulahlile umthetho, noma wanamathisela isimo sokuthi ungasetshenziswa nini? Ukuzethemba okunjani kukunikeza ukuthi izindlela ezimbili zifinyelele esiphethweni esifanayo esinyathelweni sesi-3?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha isitatimende sika-Minseo emisheni emibili noma emithathu ukuze sikwazi nokuchaza umbuzo ka-Doyun. Sho nokuthi yimiphi imigqa lo mthetho ongasetshenziswa kuyo.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bheka futhi isibalo somugqa umthetho owawungenakusetshenziswa kuwo esinyathelweni sesi-2, bese ubhala isici salowo mugqa ngamagama ambalwa.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isimo okumele singene ngaphambi komusho oqala ngo-'Uma umphumela ungu-−1'.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma imigqa emibili ingu-..., uma iyema ngqo khona ...
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Emthethweni olungisiwe, ingabe ngihlukanise 'uma umphumela ungu-−1, khona iyema ngqo' no-'uma iyema ngqo, khona umphumela ungu-−1'?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngisho ngokucacile empendulweni yami ukuthi x=2 no-y=3 ziyema ngqo yini?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngisho ncamashi, ngamagama ami, isimo lapho umthetho usebenza khona?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.model.0: Uma yomibili imigqa inama-slope, uma iyema ngqo umphumela wama-slope ungu-−1, futhi uma umphumela ungu-−1 iyema ngqo. Kodwa umugqa omile onjengo-x=2 awunayo i-slope, ngakho awukwazi ukusebenzisa lo mthetho, futhi kumele uphathe ngokwehlukana ukuthi umugqa omile nomugqa ovundlile uyema ngqo.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.model.1: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uma umphumela ungu-−1 iyema ngqo. Kodwa kunamacala lapho imigqa iyema ngqo futhi umphumela awukwazi ukutholwa, isibonelo x=2 no-y=3. Umugqa omile awunayo i-slope echaziwe, ngakho shiya leli cala ngaphandle komthetho futhi uliphathe ngokwehlukana.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isho kokubili umkhawulo womthetho nesiphetho salelo cala (iyema ngqo).

z-m-32-05.title: Emgwaqweni, kukhona indawo eyodwa kuphela lapho isilinganiso samabanga singu-2:1?
z-m-32-05.topic: Amaphoyinti okuhlukanisa angaphakathi nangaphandle ocezwini: iphoyinti elinesilinganiso samabanga esimisiwe
z-m-32-05.goal: Hlola ukuthi emugqeni, amaphoyinti onomabanga aya emaphoyinteni amabili anesilinganiso esimisiwe angaba ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle, bese uchaza ukuthi inani lamaphoyinti anjalo lishintsha kanjani uma ukhawulela kucezu noma uma isilinganiso siba ngu-1:1.
z-m-32-05.material: Epulani lezixhumanisi, cabanga ngesikwele esisodwa segridi njengo-1 km. Cabanga ukuthi umgwaqo oqondile uqhubeka ngokungapheli ezinhlangothini zombili, futhi emgwaqweni kunamadolobha amabili u-A(0, 0) no-B(6, 3). Ufuna ukumisa umbhoshongo wokudlulisa u-P kulo mgwaqo ukuze ibanga lawo kuya ku-A libe yizikhathi ezingu-2 zebanga lawo kuya ku-B. Okungukuthi, PA:PB=2:1. U-Soyun uthe, "Liyiphoyinti elihlukanisa ucezu AB ngesilinganiso esingu-2:1, ngakho liyiphoyinti elilodwa kuphela, (4, 2)."
z-m-32-05.thinking.1: Ukuthola wena amaphoyinti amaningana ahlangabezana nesimo
z-m-32-05.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani uma isimo sishintsha

z-m-32-05.prereq.1: Ukuveza iphoyinti emugqeni ngezixhumanisi (imisebenzi ye-linear yesikole esiphakathi)
z-m-32-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda isitatimende sika-Soyun bese ukhetha isinqumo sakho samanje. Zingaki izindawo emgwaqweni ezanelisa isimo sika-P?
z-m-32-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa umgwaqo ube izingxenye ezintathu, 'ngaphandle kuka-A', 'phakathi kwamadolobha amabili', no-'ngaphandle kuka-B', bese kuzo zonke izingxenye uqhathanisa ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kuka-PA no-PB elide.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kunoma iyiphi ingxenye, hambisa u-P kancane kancane bese ubona ukuthi PA÷PB ishintsha kanjani.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo samukele nje isitatimende sika-Soyun njengoba sinjalo. Hlola ukuthi sicabangele ukuthi umgwaqo awuyona ucezu kodwa ungumugqa oqhubeka ngokungapheli ezinhlangothini zombili yini.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.o.b: Izindawo ezingu-3 sekukonke (ngaphandle kuka-A, phakathi kwamadolobha amabili, ngaphandle kuka-B)
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sithathe zonke izingxenye ezintathu zomgwaqo njengabakhethiwe. Qhathanisa ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kuka-PA no-PB elide engxenyeni engaphandle kuka-A.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo savela ekuqhathaniseni u-PA no-PB ingxenye ngengxenye emgwaqweni.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.o.d: Awukwazi ukunquma inani lezindawo ngezixhumanisi kuphela
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.d: Zonke izixhumanisi ziyanikezwa, ngakho ungahlola abakhethiwe bese unquma inani. Ungahlulela ngokuqhathanisa ubude ingxenye ngengxenye.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.explain: Kunendawo eyodwa phakathi kuka-A no-B nendawo eyodwa ngaphandle kuka-B, ngakho izindawo ezingu-2 sekukonke. Ngaphandle kuka-A, u-B ukude njalo kunalo u-A, ngakho PA ayikwazi ukuba yizikhathi ezingu-2 zika-PB.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.prompt: Faka amaphoyinti angu-3 ahlukene P(x, y) emgwaqweni lapho PA:PB ingu-2:1 noma 1:2.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.hint.0: Veza iphoyinti emgwaqweni ngohlukile oyedwa. Isibonelo, cabanga ukuthi udinga ukuya izikhathi ezingaki ngesiqondiso esisuka ku-A siye ku-B.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nciphisa umgwaqo ube umugqa owodwa wezinombolo no-A ku-0 no-B ku-3, thola izindawo lapho isilinganiso samabanga amabili sifanelana nesimo, bese uzibuyisela emgwaqweni wokuqala.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Akuyona iphoyinti emgwaqweni. Sebenzisa izixhumanisi zika-A no-B ukuthola ukuthi yini ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate yephoyinti emgwaqweni.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.ok.c2: PA iyizikhathi ezingu-2 zika-PB, noma PB iyizikhathi ezingu-2 zika-PA.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.fail.c2: PA:PB akungu-2:1 noma 1:2. Thola amabanga amabili bese uwaqhathanisa.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.explain: Kunciphisiwe kube umugqa wezinombolo no-A ku-0 no-B ku-3, ama-P ane-PA=2PB angu-2 (phakathi kuka-A no-B) no-6 (ngaphandle kuka-B), futhi ama-P ane-PB=2PA angu-1 (phakathi kuka-A no-B) no-−3 (ngaphandle kuka-A). Abuyiselwe ezixhumanisini zomgwaqo, angu-(4, 2), (12, 6), (2, 1), (−6, −3). (3, 1.5) iphakathi ncamashi kwamadolobha womabili, ngakho isilinganiso sayo singu-1:1.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngaphansi kwesimo sokuqala (PA:PB=2:1), uma u-P ekhawulelwe ocezwini AB, bangaki abakhethiwe? Futhi uma isilinganiso sishintshwa saba ngu-1:1, bangaki abakhethiwe emgwaqweni (umugqa)? Bhala inani lezindawo ndawonye nesizathu.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi yimaphi amaphoyinti ahlangabezana nesimo sokuqala PA:PB=2:1 asocezwini AB.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.hint.1: Uma isilinganiso singu-1:1, beka u-P ngaphandle kuka-A bese uqhathanisa ukuthi yiliphi phakathi kuka-PA no-PB elide.

z-m-32-05.s.s3.model.0: Uma ukhawulela u-P ocezwini AB, kusala kuphela (4, 2). Uma isilinganiso singu-1:1, khona noma emugqeni kunephoyinti elilodwa kuphela maphakathi. Iphoyinti langaphandle lihlala liseduze nelinye ledolobha, ngakho amabanga awakwazi ukulingana.

z-m-32-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Iphendula icala elinomkhawulo wesigaba nelicala le-1:1 ngokwehlukana futhi inikeza izizathu.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.model.2: Ngaphakathi kwesigaba kunephoyinti elilodwa, (4,2), futhi nge-1:1 kunendawo maphakathi kuphela. Ngaphandle, amabanga ahlukile.

z-m-32-06.title: Ingabe imigqa edwetshwe ngokushintsha k ingaba yonke imigqa edlula kuleli phoyinti?
z-m-32-06.topic: Umndeni wemigqa edlula epoyinti, nomugqa ongekho
z-m-32-06.goal: Hlukanisa ukuqiniseka okutholwe ezibonelweni eziningana nokuhlola wonke amacala, bese usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo ukuchaza ukuthi kungani umndeni wemigqa onepharamitha k ungaqukethe yonke imigqa edlula epoyinti.
z-m-32-06.material: Kunoma yiliphi inani langempela le-k, kunqunywa umugqa owodwa l_k: kx−y+2k+1=0. (l_k ifundwa 'l sub k', futhi isibalo sifundwa 'k times x minus y plus 2k plus 1 equals zero'. Akukho sithombe.) UDaeun udwebe imigqa y=1, y=x+3, y=−x−1 ye-k=0, 1, −1, futhi yonke imigqa emithathu yadlula epoyintini (−2, 1). UDaeun uthe, "Yonke i-l_k idlula ku-(−2, 1). Ngakho yonke imigqa edlula ku-(−2, 1) kumele ibe phakathi kwama-l_k."

z-m-32-06.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka iphoyinti (−2, 1) esibalweni kunikeza k×(−2)−1+2k+1=0, okusebenza noma ngabe k iyini. Ukuqoqa izibonelo eziningi kukhulisa ukuqiniseka kwakho, kodwa isiqinisekiso sokuthi kusebenza kuwo wonke k sivela ekuhloleni okugcina u-k njengohlamvu.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuqoqa izibonelo eziningi yisinyathelo sokuqala esizwakalayo esakha ukuqiniseka. Kodwa ukuthola isiqinisekiso sika-'wonke k', udinga uhlolo olulodwa olugcina u-k njengohlamvu.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.prompt: Hlola umcabango wesibili kaDaeun, 'yonke imigqa edlula ku-(−2, 1) ngu-l_k othile'. Faka amaphoyinti ama-3 ahlukile (p, q) angalali ku-l_k nganoma yiliphi inani langempela le-k olikhethayo.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.hint.0: Misa iphoyinti elilodwa (p, q), alifake esibalweni, yenza isibalo lapho k kuphela esala, bese ubona ukuthi u-k ungatholakala yini.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ukuthi ngenani liphi le-p igama elinenombolo k, k(p+2), linyamalala.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Lena iphoyinti elingalali ku-l_k noma ngabe k okhethayo iyini.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Leli phoyinti lilala ku-l_k uma ukhetha k efanele. Faka amakhodineti ephoyinti esibalweni bese ulithatha njengesibalo se-k. Kunini lapho kungenakwenzeka ukuthola k?
z-m-32-06.s.s2.explain: Ukufaka iphoyinti (p, q) esibalweni kunikeza k(p+2)=q−1. Uma p=−2, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-0 noma ngabe k iyini, ngakho lusebenza kuphela uma q=1, futhi uma q≠1 alusebenzi kunoma yiliphi k. Wonke la maphoyinti alala emugqeni x=−2. (0, 3) ise-l_1 uma k=1, no-(−2, 1) isemigqeni yonke l_k.
z-m-32-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala lokho ongakutshela uDaeun. (1) Yimuphi umugqa odlula epoyintini (−2, 1) kodwa ongabhalwa njenge-l_k? (2) Kungani lowo mugqa ungekho?
z-m-32-06.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba amaphoyinti owenze esinyathelweni 2 endizeni yamakhodineti bese ubona ukuthi alala emugqeni owodwa yini.
z-m-32-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala kabusha i-l_k ngomumo y=(…) bese ubuka ukuthi k inquma ini.

z-m-32-06.s.s3.model.0: Umugqa oqondile x=−2 awukho. i-l_k ngu-y=k(x+2)+1, ngakho k idlala indima yokuthambeka, futhi umugqa oqondile awunakuthambeka, ngakho akukho k angawenza.
z-m-32-06.s.s3.model.1: Umugqa x=−2, odlula ku-(−2, 1) kodwa ohambisana nomzila we-y, awuvelanga kunoma yiliphi k. Lokhu kungoba umumo y−1=k(x+2) umela kuphela imigqa enokuthambeka k.

z-m-32-01.title: Uma kunikezwe amaphoyinti amathathu, i-vertex yesine iyodwa kuphela?
z-m-32-01.goal: Sebenzisa izixhumanisi ukuhlola ukuthi, ku-parallelogram enamaphoyinti amathathu anikeziwe, kungase kube nama-vertex ayisine amaningana kuye ngokuthi iliphi iphoyinti ebhekene nalo, bese uchaza ukuthi kuguquka ini uma amaphoyinti amathathu elele emgqeni owodwa.
z-m-32-01.material: Endizeni yezixhumanisi kunamaphoyinti amathathu u-A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(1, 3). Ufuna ukwenza i-parallelogram enala maphoyinti amathathu kanye neleye elilodwa u-D njengama-vertex. Ukulandelana kwamagama ama-vertex akulungisiwe. Okungukuthi, u-D angabhekana noma ngu-A, B, noma C. UHayun wathola u-D=(5, 4) futhi wathi, "Leli kuphela iphoyinti lesine elingenzeka." (I-parallelogram umumo lapho amaphoyinti amane engekho wonke emgqeni owodwa. Isikwele esisodwa segridi sinobude obufanayo ezinhlangothini zonke.)
z-m-32-01.thinking.1: Ukwakha izixazululo eziningana ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo wena
z-m-32-01.thinking.2: Ukuthola isimo sokuthi isebenze (amaphoyinti amathathu akekho emgqeni owodwa)
z-m-32-01.prereq.0: I-geometry yesikole esiphakathi: incazelo nezimfanelo ze-parallelogram
z-m-32-01.prereq.1: Ukufunda izixhumanisi zamaphoyinti endizeni yezixhumanisi, nokwengeza nokukhipha izixhumanisi
z-m-32-01.prereq.2: Ukulandelana kwesikole okucatshangwayo: kucabanga ukuthi umfundi uqedile izibalo zesikole esiphakathi (imisebenzi eqondile, i-Pythagorean theorem, izimfanelo zemiumo) futhi usanda kuqala iyunithi yama-equation emiumo ye-High School Common Mathematics. U-'H1' ulebula nje yezinga lobunzima nosizo lalo msebenzi wokukhiqiza, hhayi ukubekwa kwebanga kuhlelo lwezifundo.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.prompt: Uma uqala ukufunda isitatimende sikaHayun, usihlulela kanjani? Khetha esisondele kakhulu kulokho ocabanga kona manje. (Kulungile ukuphutha. Uzoyihlola wena ezinyathelweni ezingezansi.)
z-m-32-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba u-A, B no-C njengamaphoyinti endizeni yezixhumanisi bese uhlanganisa amaphoyinti amathathu ukudweba unxantathu.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ku-parallelogram, ama-diagonal amabili ahlangana maphakathi komunye nomunye. Uma unquma ukuthi u-D uhlezi ebhekene nelinye lamaphoyinti u-A, B, C, dweba ukuthi indawo luka-D izohluka kanjani.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sahlulelo sicabanga ukuthi uma amaphoyinti amathathu elungisiwe, eliphela nalo lilungisiwe. Kodwa inkinga yathi u-D ubhekene nephoyinti liphi?
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.b: Lesi isahlulelo sokuthi amaphoyinti amabili kuphela angabhekana. Bala ukuthi mangaki kuma-A, B, C angabhekana no-D.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.c: Zonke izixhumanisi zinikeziwe, ngakho ungabala inani. Ungacabanga ukuthi lizoguquka kanjani uma izikhundla zamaphoyinti zazihlukile.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.d: Lesi isahlulelo esenziwe ngokubala ngenkathi kushintshwa iphoyinti elibhekene no-D. Esinyathelweni esingezansi, sizowenza ngokwethu ukuhlola ukuthi leli nani lilungile yini.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.explain: Uma amaphoyinti amathathu engekho emgqeni owodwa, icala lapho u-D ebhekene no-A, icala lapho ebhekene no-B, nelicala lapho ebhekene no-C ngalinye lenza i-parallelogram eyodwa, ngakho kunama-3. U-(5, 4) ungomunye wabo. Esinyathelweni esilandelayo uzozakhela ukuhlola.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.prompt: Faka izixhumanisi ezingu-3 ezihlukile luka-D (x, y). Kuphela amaphoyinti enza i-parallelogram kanye no-A, B no-C amukelwa. (U-(5, 4) kaHayun ubalwa njengoyedwa wabo.)
z-m-32-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba umumo oxhumanisa amaphoyinti amane no-D=(5, 4) kaHayun, bese uthola ukuthi liyiphi phakathi kuka-A, B, C elibhekene no-D.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi izingxenye ezimbili ezixhumanisa ama-vertex aphambene zihlobana kanjani komunye nomunye, bese ushintsha lobo budlelwano ube ukubala ngezixhumanisi.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Lokhu kwenza i-parallelogram lapho u-D ebhekene nelinye lika-A, B no-C.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Leli phoyinti alenzi i-parallelogram. Bheka umumo wezingxenye ezimbili ezixhumanisa amapheya ama-vertex aphambene.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.explain: Uma u-D ebhekene no-A ungu-(5, 4), uma ebhekene no-B ungu-(−3, 2), futhi uma ebhekene no-C ungu-(3, −2). Kuwo wonke amacala amathathu, izingxenye ezimbili ezixhumanisa amapheya amabili ama-vertex aphambene ziyahlangana maphakathi komunye nomunye.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.prompt: Uma amaphoyinti amathathu esemgqeni owodwa, njengo-A(0, 0), P(1, 1), Q(2, 2), mangaki amaphoyinti angenzeka luka-D? Bhala inani nesizathu emshweni owodwa noma emibili.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba u-A, P no-Q endizeni yezixhumanisi bese ubona ukuthi la maphoyinti amathathu enza unxantathu yini.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dweba umumo amaphoyinti amane awenzayo uma u-D emgqeni nalapho engekho emgqeni.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngixhumanise iqiniso lokuthi amaphoyinti amathathu awenzi unxantathu nesiphetho sokuthi akukho parallelogram engenzeka?
z-m-32-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngicabange ngokubili icala lapho u-D emgqeni nelicala lapho engekho emgqeni?
z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.0: Uma amaphoyinti amathathu esemgqeni owodwa, noma ngabe ubeka u-D kuphi awukwazi ukwenza i-parallelogram. Amaphoyinti amathathu kumele enze unxantathu ukuze amacala angu-3, ashintsha iphoyinti elibhekene, avele.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.1: U-A, P no-Q basemgqeni oqondile, ngakho akukho nxantathu owakhiwayo, futhi noma u-D emgqeni noma engekho emgqeni, akukho parallelogram eyakhiwayo, ngakho inani lingu-0.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kuhle ukuthi uhlukanise u-D emgqeni nangaphandle komugqa.

z-m-32-03.title: Isibalo sesiyingi esihambisiwe sibukeka siphutha: sahamba kuphi?
z-m-32-03.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni sesibalo sesibalo esihambisiwe, lapho isiqondiso sokuhambisa sasetshenziswa ngokuphambene, bese uhlukanisa ukuhlolwa okungabonisa iphutha nokungenakulibonisa.
z-m-32-03.material: U-Seoyun uxazulule isibalo sesiyingi C: (x+1)²+(y−2)²=9 esihambiswe ngo-+3 esiqondisweni se-x no-−4 esiqondisweni se-y, njengoba kuboniswe ngezansi. (+3 esiqondisweni se-x kusho amayunithi angu-3 ngakwesokudla, futhi −4 esiqondisweni se-y kusho amayunithi angu-4 phansi. Umthetho wokuhambisa iphoyinti elilodwa ukuthi (x, y) liye ku-(x+3, y−4). Isibalo sesiyingi C sifundwa 'x plus 1 squared plus y minus 2 squared equals 9'.)
z-m-32-03.thinking.0: Ukuthola umugqa lapho iphutha laqala khona esixazululweni
z-m-32-03.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa isibalo esilungisiwe ukwakha ukunyakaza okuhlangabezana nesimo
z-m-32-03.prereq.0: Incazelo yesibalo sesiyingi (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r² (isikhungo (a, b), i-radius r)
z-m-32-03.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa iphoyinti (x, y) ngo-p esiqondisweni se-x no-q esiqondisweni se-y kunikeza (x+p, y+q)
z-m-32-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sika-Seoyun ophutha.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umugqa ngamunye bese uhlola, umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi ulandela ngokwemvelo emphumeleni womugqa owandulelayo yini.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa iphoyinti olitholayo ngokuhambisa isikhungo sesiyingi C ngomthetho wenkinga nesikhungo emugqeni wokugcina ka-Seoyun.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.0: Thola isibalo sesimo esitholwa ngokuhambisa isiyingi C ngo-+3 esiqondisweni se-x no-−4 esiqondisweni se-y.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.1: Uma iphoyinti (x, y) esimweni lihanjiswa, liba ngu-(x+3, y−4), ngakho shintsha u-x ngo-x+3 no-y ngo-y−4 esibalweni.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.explain: Kwaphutha emugqeni 2. Iphoyinti (X, Y) esimweni esihambisiwe liyiphoyinti (X−3, Y+4) lesimo sokuqala elihambile, ngakho u-X−3 no-Y+4 kumele bangene ezindaweni zika-x no-y esibalweni sokuqala. Isibalo sika-Seoyun sithumela isikhungo ku-(−4, 6), kodwa ukuhambisa isikhungo sokuqala (−1, 2) ngo-(+3, −4) kunikeza (2, −2). Ukuhlola: iphoyinti (−1, 5) esiyingini C lihamba liye ku-(2, 1), futhi ukufaka leli phoyinti esibalweni esisha sika-Seoyun kunikeza 6²+(−5)²=61, hhayi 9. Imigqa 3 kuya ku-5 ilandela nje emphumeleni womugqa 2.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngemva kokuthi u-Seoyun eqeda isixazululo, yikuphi ukuhlolwa okungaba usizo ekuqapheleni iphutha ngokushesha? Khetha konke ukuhlolwa okungabonisa ngempela iphutha kulesi sixazululo.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi yiliphi inani esibalweni esisha sika-Seoyun elingashintshanga esibalweni sokuqala.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi iphutha lingendawo noma ngosayizi, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa ngakunye kubheka leli nani yini.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.a: Hlola ukuthi uhlangothi lwesokudla lwesibalo esisha lusengu-9 futhi i-radius isengu-3
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.a: Kulesi sixazululo i-radius ifana nangaphambili, ngakho lokhu kuhlolwa kuphela akubonisi iphutha. Cabanga ukuthi lokhu kuhlolwa kubheka isimo sesimo noma indawo yaso.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.b: Hambisa isikhungo sesiyingi C ngomthetho ofanayo bese uqhathanisa nesikhungo esibalweni esisha
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.b: Lo mqondo ukubala indawo ngemva kokuhambisa ngqo ngomthetho wokuhambisa bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.c: Nweba isibalo esisha bese uhlola ukuthi ama-coefficient ka-x² no-y² asengu-1 yini
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.c: Ama-coefficient awashintshi ngaphansi kokuhambisa, ngakho ahlala efana nakuma-xazululo angalungile. Lokhu kuhlolwa akubheki isiqondiso noma usayizi wokuhambisa.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.d: Hambisa iphoyinti elilodwa esiyingini C ngomthetho ofanayo bese ulifaka esibalweni esisha ukubona ukuthi lifanela yini
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.d: Lo mqondo uhlola ngqo ukuthi iphoyinti lapho iphoyinti lesimo sokuqala lihamba khona lanelisa isibalo esisha yini.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.explain: Isibalo esisha sika-Seoyun sine-radius efanayo nama-coefficient ka-x² no-y² afanayo nangaphambili, ngakho ukuhlola a no-c kudlulile. Iphutha 'lisendaweni ngemva kokuhambisa', ngakho ukuhlola b no-d, okuhambisa isikhungo noma iphoyinti esimweni ngomthetho ofanayo bese kuqhathanisa nesibalo esisha, kubonisa iphutha.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.prompt: Uhambise isiyingi C ngo-p esiqondisweni se-x no-q esiqondisweni se-y (i-radius ihlala ingu-3 ngemva kokuhambisa), futhi saba yisiyingi esidlula endaweni eyisisekelo (0, 0). Faka ama-(p, q) angu-3 ahlukene angenzeka. (Amadesimali kulungile.)
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale isikhungo esisha, okuyisikhungo (−1, 2) sesiyingi C esihanjiswe ngo-p no-q, ngo-p no-q.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa ngesikhungo esisha nendawo eyisisekelo iqiniso lokuthi wonke amaphoyinti esiyingini ayibanga elimisiwe kusukela esikhungweni.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Isiyingi esihanjisiwe asidluli endaweni eyisisekelo. Bhala isikhungo esisha ngo-p no-q bese uhlola ibanga eliya endaweni eyisisekelo.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.explain: Isikhungo esisha singu-(−1+p, 2+q), futhi ukuze indawo eyisisekelo ibe esiyingini, ibanga phakathi kwendawo eyisisekelo nesikhungo esisha kumele libe i-radius engu-3. Okungukuthi, (p−1)²+(q+2)²=9. Izixazululo eziphelele ngu-(4, −2), (−2, −2), (1, 1), (1, −5), futhi kunezixazululo zamadesimali nazo. Ngokunyakaza (3, −4) enkingeni yokuqala, isikhungo esisha singu-(2, −2), futhi ibanga laso kusuka endaweni eyisisekelo lingu-√8, ngakho isiyingi asidluli endaweni eyisisekelo.

z-m-32-04.title: Ulwazi lokuthi 'bathinta endaweni eyodwa kuphela' lwanele?
z-m-32-04.topic: Indawo yezindingilizi ezimbili nebanga phakathi kwezikhungo zazo
z-m-32-04.goal: Funda ukuthi ulwazi lokuthi izindingilizi ezimbili zihlangana endaweni eyodwa alumisi ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo libe linye, sho ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo, bese uchaza ibanga lamabanga lapho zihlangana khona emaphoyinteni amabili.
z-m-32-04.material: Ibhedi lezimbali eliyindingilizi u-A linesikhungo endaweni eyisisekelo O(0, 0) ne-radius engu-3 (iyunithi: m). Njengesibalo, ngu-x²+y²=9. Ibhedi lezimbali u-B liyisiyingi esine-radius engu-5 (iyunithi: m), futhi indawo yesikhungo saso ayikanqunywa. Uhlelo lusho kuphela ukuthi 'imigqa yemiphetho yamabhedi amabili izimbali ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela'. U-Jion uthe, "Bathinta endaweni eyodwa kuphela, ngakho ibanga d phakathi kwezikhungo ezimbili ngu-3+5=8." (Cabanga ngomngcele njengomugqa ongenabukhulu. Uma izindingilizi ezimbili zihlukene, noma uma isiyingi esisodwa silele ngokuphelele ngaphakathi komunye, imigqa yemingcele yazo ayihlangani.)

z-m-32-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lokuthi 'imigqa yemingcele ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela' lungamisa d libe inani linye? Khetha isinqumo esifaneleke kakhulu.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba isiyingi se-radius engu-3, bese udweba isithombe esisodwa esinesiyingi se-radius engu-5 sithinta kusuka ngaphandle nesinye sithinta kusuka ngaphakathi.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.1: Esithombeni ngasinye, bhala ubude bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ibanga phakathi kwezikhungo ezimbili lihlobene kanjani nama-radius amabili.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.a: d engenzeka ngu-8 noma u-2, amanani amabili, ngakho ayimiswanga libe linye
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo sicabange ukuthi indlela yokuthinta ihlukana ibe yimbili.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sicabange kuphela ngecala lapho izindingilizi ezimbili zithinta kusuka ngaphandle. Dweba ukuthi icala lapho isiyingi esisodwa sithinta esinye ngaphakathi nalo lihlangana endaweni eyodwa yini.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.c: Lesi sinqumo sibone kuphela icala lapho isiyingi esincane sithinta isiyingi esikhulu ngaphakathi. Izindingilizi ezithinta kusuka ngaphandle nazo zihlangana endaweni eyodwa.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.d: Kudingeka ulwazi olwengeziwe, ngakho awukwazi ukusho inani lika-d
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.d: Isinqumo sokuthi kudingeka okwengeziwe sisemthethweni. Kodwa cabanga ukuthi ungasho yini nokuthi yimuphi ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kuye ngalo, d iyoba yimuphi kwangaki amanani.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.explain: Kunamacala amabili lapho izindingilizi ezimbili zihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela. Uma zithinta kusuka ngaphandle, d=3+5=8, futhi uma isiyingi esincane u-A sithinta ngaphakathi kwesiyingi esikhulu u-B, d=5−3=2. Ngakho udinga ukwazi kakhulu ngokuthi 'zithinta ngayiphi indlela' ukuze d imiswe libe linye.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.acc.0: Isiphetho sokuthi ulwazi alwanele silungile. Ukuqhubeka isinyathelo esisodwa, uma wazi 'ukuthi zithinta kusuka ngaphandle noma ngaphakathi', d imiswa ibe ngu-8 noma u-2.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.prompt: Nquma isikhungo (x, y) sebhedi lezimbali u-B bese wenza ukuhlelwa lapho imigqa yemingcele emibili ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela. Usuqedile uma ufaka ukuhlelwa okubili lapho amabanga asuka endaweni eyisisekelo aya esikhungweni sika-B ehlukile.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isikwele sebanga elisuka endaweni eyisisekelo liya esikhungweni ngo-x no-y.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qala unqume ibanga kwamacala amabili lapho zihlangana endaweni eyodwa, bese ukhetha iphoyinti elilodwa ibanga ngalinye.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Imigqa yemingcele emibili ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ngalesi sikhungo, imigqa yemingcele emibili ayihlangani endaweni eyodwa (ayihlangani, noma ihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili). Qhathanisa ibanga elisuka endaweni eyisisekelo liye esikhungweni nama-radius amabili.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.explain: Uma ibanga elisuka endaweni eyisisekelo liya esikhungweni lingu-8, zithinta kusuka ngaphandle (isb. (8, 0)), futhi uma lingu-2, zithinta kusuka ngaphakathi (isb. (0, 2)). Uma amabanga elingana (isb. (8, 0) no-(0, 8)), kuyizinhlobo zokuhlela ezifanayo, ngakho ubale njengeyodwa.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukwandisa d kancane kancane kusukela ku-0. Bhala ibanga lika-d lapho imigqa yemingcele emibili ihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukene, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani liwo lelo banga usebenzisa indlela eyodwa. (Chaza ngamagama esikhundleni sesithombe.)
z-m-32-04.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa amabanga okuhlelwa okubili owakwenza esinyathelweni sesi-2 njengezithenjwa, dweba ngokungaphelele ukuthi izindingilizi ezimbili zilala kanjani emabangeni aphakathi kwawo naphandle kwawo.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ngokwehlukana ukuthi izindingilizi ezimbili zithinta uma d incane kuno-2 nalapho d inkulu kuno-8.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma d ingu-..., zihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili. Ngoba ...
z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi imikhawulo emibili yebanga lapho zihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili (d=2, d=8) ayifakiwe?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngichaze ukuthi imigqa yemingcele emibili ibukeka kanjani uma d incane kuno-2 nalapho d inkulu kuno-8?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe isizathu engisibhalile singafinyelela kumfundi noma ngaphandle kwesithombe?
z-m-32-04.s.s3.model.0: Uma 2<d<8, zihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili. Uma d=2 zithinta endaweni eyodwa kusuka ngaphakathi, futhi uma d=8 zithinta endaweni eyodwa kusuka ngaphandle, ngakho phakathi, izindingilizi ezimbili ziyagqagqana sengathi ziyawelana futhi zihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.model.1: Kungu-d inkulu kuno-umehluko wama-radius amabili, 5−3=2, futhi incane kunesamba sawo, 3+5=8. Uma d inkulu kunesamba, zihlukene, futhi uma incane kunomehluko, isiyingi esincane siphakathi kwesiyingi esikhulu, ngakho azihlangani.
z-m-32-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ichaza amanani omngcele isebenzisa umehluko nesamba sama-radius.
